psychological_meaning: Deep blue often evokes feelings of tranquility, peace, and stability. It is associated with depth, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith, truth, and heaven. It is a color that can promote relaxation and reduce stress, while also symbolizing loyalty and trustworthiness. However, in some contexts, it can also be associated with sadness or melancholy.
